iti86:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti86:2.2: dhammānudhammapaṭipanno’yanti. bhāsamāno dhammaññeva bhāsati no adhammaṃ. vitakkayamāno vā dhammavitakkaññeva vitakketi no adhammavitakkaṃ. tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno’ti.
iti86:5.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
